reasons.plausibility: Substituting Ta with Nb to reduce density while preserving a BCC matrix for strength is scientifically sound, with only minor uncertainties about high-temperature performance.
reasons.testability: Comparing density and mechanical properties of the new alloy composition vs. the baseline provides a clear, decisive experiment to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Replacing heavier elements with lighter ones to lower density without sacrificing high-temperature strength is a straightforward and highly relevant approach for improving these alloys.
